human_sources.role: The forward and inverse conjugator tests and convergence of the cumulative cocycles occur in [Masuda] below, pp.60–62. This lesson isolates the required general convergence statements, supplies the predual inverse-map argument and the moving-input estimate, and examines the unilateral-shift and scalar-phase obstructions. These details explain the classical convergence mechanism; they do not make that mechanism a new construction.
